headline: Microsoft adds two new mouse tools to PowerToys
summary: Microsoft released PowerToys 0.102, adding two new mouse utilities alongside new command-line tools and Command Palette improvements; the free Windows utility suite now includes more than 30 tools in total.

claims.statement: Microsoft's PowerToys update adds two new mouse tools.

sources.quote: adds CursorHide, Button Lock mouse tools
gives your mouse 2 new tricks for free

claims.statement: The update also adds new command-line tools and Command Palette improvements.

sources.quote: new command-line tools, and Command Palette improvements

claims.statement: PowerToys now includes more than 30 tools in total.
